name: אֶפְלָל
summary: Ephlal son of Zabad, of Judah through Sheshan's daughter and his Egyptian servant Jarha, father of Obed (1Ch 2:34–37). The name has the consonants פלל with a prefixed א; it may be a noun of the root, “judgment”, or a verb form, but scripture does not explain it and the reading is uncertain.

evidence.note: “Zabad fathered אֶפְלָל, and Ephlal fathered Obed.”
His line: Sheshan gave his daughter to Jarha, and Zabad descends from them.
The verb the name is read from: “God פִּלְלוֹ”.

note: Takes q.bq.ai (2 tokens; a.fb.ah is a zero-token cross-reference). The א-prefixed form is unusual for a noun of a geminate root; whether it is “judgment” or a first-person verb is not decided.
